title: AION 2

anticheat.note: NCGuard stops the game in every sync mode tried (highball#315)

provenance: Tested by krptg0 (highball#315, 2026-10-10), Apple M2 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, in all three sync modes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Does not start, NCGuard, the game's anti-cheat, stops it. With msync NCGuard exits about 8 seconds in with 0xE0000015 on a fresh environment (2 of 2 tries). With sync off NCGuard finishes its setup, then the game spins on its splash screen at about 157% CPU for over seven minutes without loading anything (3 of 3). With esync Steam crashes before the game starts (1 of 1).
